Q9029.reason: Hypotonic water absorbed across the bladder mucosa can cause fluid and electrolyte imbalance, which is why saline is used for washout.

Q9030.reason: Under the modern rule the parties may modify a third-party beneficiary contract before the beneficiary assents, sues, or relies, and the son learned of it only after payment.

Q9031.reason: A general ban on assigning the contract does not bar assignment of the right to payment unless that right is specifically restricted.
